description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Hadrian builds software for autonomous manufacturing. The Frontend Software Engineer will develop full-stack applications that extract and manage engineering data, orchestrate AI tools, and help users review and edit 2D and 3D technical materials.
All Levels Frontend Software Engineer building PDF/3D CAD viewers, annotation and review workflows, agent interfaces, and high-performance rendering.

Responsibilities:
• Build the applications engineers use to read drawings and models, including a high performance PDF viewer, annotation overlays, and 3D CAD views with PMI
• Design review workflows where people confirm, correct, or reject what an agent proposed, with every edit recorded
• Build agent driven interfaces that call the same tools a user does and show their answers in the drawing
• Own performance on large documents and models - including rendering, streaming, caching, and keeping the UI responsive with thousands of entities on screen
• Engage in product discovery alongside manufacturing engineers and operators - help define what needs to exist and what needs to be better
• Work closely with our ML engineers on what the agents produce and how it reaches the user

Requirements:
• Expert in TypeScript and React, with a deep understanding of state management, rendering, and the frontend ecosystem
• AI native builder with strong product sense and user empathy
• Experience building graphics heavy applications on Canvas, WebGL, three.js, or similar
• Strong ability and desire to build a high quality codebase
• Bias towards action and take pride in your work
• Excited to work in a fast-paced environment with high-stakes and quick iteration cycles
• To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) you must be a U.S. citizen or national, lawful permanent resident, protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State

Preferred:
• Have a strong sense of design and execute at a high level with or without design support
• Experience with CAD/CAM software, 3D environments, or document and PDF rendering
• Experience with WebAssembly, web workers, and other techniques for high performance web applications
• Experience building interfaces for LLM agents, including chat, tool calls, and human review of model output
• Comfortable jumping into other areas of our stack as needed: Node, Python, SQL
• Previously worked in aerospace, defense, or manufacturing, or with engineering drawings and GD&T
• You have a passion for manufacturing and believe that the industry needs better software
